'''The Mad Clone of Kaikielius''', as he was dubbed by [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] commentators, was an aberrant [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Like all clone troopers, he was cloned from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Unlike most aberrant clones, he went unnoticed during training and conditioning in the [[clone military education complex]] in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], and when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out, he was part of the Republic contingent that fought in the [[Kaikielius campaign]].

During a reconnaissance mission in the campaign, the clone trooper suddenly went berserk and killed the rest of his [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. He was later found sitting docilely on an outcropping, surrounded by his batchers' bodies. Under questioning by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]], the Mad Clone insisted that he had been on a training mission and that his batchers had been replaced by disguised [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. He even congratulated his interrogators on the realism of the "training mission", claiming that he had almost been fooled by the droids using familiar unit codenames.
